name: Dalar Dawnweaver
summary: At the Sepulcher, Dalar Dawnweaver turns his arcane learning toward the Forsaken’s enemies. Once an archmage of Dalaran, he died when the Scourge destroyed the city and later broke free of the Lich King’s control. Now he studies Dalaran’s lingering presence and seeks to end the madness of Archmage Arugal.

sections.title: A Fallen Archmage
sections.body: Dalar Dawnweaver once held high rank among the Kirin Tor, walking the Violet Citadel’s halls when Dalaran stood at the height of arcane mastery. His mortal life ended when the Scourge sacked the city to prepare for Archimonde’s summoning. Raised as a mindless thrall of the Lich King, Dalar broke free alongside Lady Sylvanas Windrunner when the Scourge’s grip faltered. Now at the Sepulcher, he keeps an archmage’s keen intellect and devotes it to protecting the Forsaken realm.

sections.title: Eyes on Ambermill and Shadowfang
sections.body: Silverpine Forest faces many dangers, and Dalar directs the Sepulcher’s arcane strategy. To the south, Dalaran wizards occupy Ambermill, where they pursue matters he aims to uncover and disrupt. Shadowfang Keep lies closer, its feral worgen prowling the woods. Dalar knows his former colleague, Archmage Arugal, well. He carefully directs efforts to stop Arugal’s beastly creations before they overrun the region.

faq.answer: Dalar Dawnweaver is a Forsaken mage at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. He was once an archmage of the Kirin Tor in Dalaran. After dying during the Third War and being raised by the Scourge, he broke free of the Lich King’s control and joined the Dark Lady.

faq.q: What happened to him during the Third War?
faq.answer: Dalar was in Dalaran when Arthas Menethil and the Scourge invaded to recover the Book of Medivh. He died in the assault as Kel’Thuzad summoned Archimonde into Azeroth, then was raised as a servant of the Scourge until Sylvanas freed him.

faq.q: Why is Dalar stationed at the Sepulcher?
faq.answer: Dalar is the Forsaken’s local arcane authority in Silverpine Forest. He knows the Kirin Tor forces occupying Ambermill and his former peer, Archmage Arugal, making him well placed to counter both threats.

faq.q: What is Dalar's connection to Archmage Arugal?
faq.answer: Dalar and Archmage Arugal were both Kirin Tor mages in Dalaran before its fall. Dalar understands the tragic course and deadly danger of Arugal’s summoning experiments in Shadowfang Keep. He sends adventurers to gather relics of Arugal’s folly and ultimately demands the mad mage’s death.

faq.q: What does Dalar want with Dalaran's remnants?
faq.answer: Dalar watches his former homeland and the surviving Kirin Tor forces at Ambermill. He directs agents to intercept their messages and study their intentions, so they cannot threaten the Forsaken in Silverpine.

faq.q: Is Dalar aligned with the Kirin Tor?
faq.answer: No. Dalar was once an archmage among the Kirin Tor, but his loyalty now belongs to the Forsaken and the Horde. He actively opposes the surviving Kirin Tor forces in Silverpine Forest.

angles.text: As a Forsaken mage, you can see in Dalar a dark reflection of Dalaran’s former grandeur. His Kirin Tor training now serves the Dark Lady.
As an undead, you can see Dalar reclaiming his agency as a Forsaken. He turns the knowledge he gained in life against Dalaran’s remnants and rogue wizards who threaten their sovereignty.
At the Sepulcher, Dalar helps secure the Horde’s western frontier. He coordinates strikes against the worgen of Shadowfang Keep and hostile Kirin Tor enclaves.
